subsystems.name: BlueStore
subsystems.description: On-disk layout, blobs/extents, allocation, checksums/compression, BlueFS and the BlueStore write path.

subsystems.name: RocksDB & metadata

subsystems.name: Crimson & Seastar
subsystems.description: Crimson OSD, SeaStore, sharded execution, cross-core messaging, async I/O, messenger and SPDK integration.

subsystems.name: OSD performance

subsystems.name: Memory management
subsystems.description: Allocation, caches and eviction, buffer lifetime/refcounting, leaks, fragmentation, memory pressure.

subsystems.name: CephFS
subsystems.description: MDS metadata cache, locking and journaling, subtree migration and balancing, snapshots and quotas, the client/libcephfs I/O path, mirroring and MDS map handling.

subsystems.name: Major architectural changes
subsystems.description: New abstractions or subsystem boundaries, core interfaces/data structures, transaction semantics, concurrency model, cross-subsystem refactors.
